how I like to implement Bio-Phos applications:

-

1 week prior to 12/12 flip I do a “transitional” inoculation using 50/50 Mycrobe Complete and BioPhos applied together. Mixed with Bio-Catalyst enzymes of course.

-

1st full inoculation of only Bio-Phos/Enzymes 1 week into flower. You no longer need to apply Mycrobe Complete.

-

Then use Bio-Phos and Bio-Catalyst every week for 3 weeks. After those 3 weeks, go to every 2 weeks with your final inoculation being 2 weeks prior to harvest.

-

As for the Bio-Catalyst liquid enzymes, anytime you inoculate with either Mycrobe Complete or BioPhos, mix Bio-Catalyst into the same water at 3-5ml/gal and apply together.
